en: This is a classic postcard with an image of a waterfront harbor, with sailing ships docked on the right and a cityscape on the left. The city is labeled 'Sundsvall,' and there is a visible stamp with the text 'LOGEN RÄTT och SANNING BASAR SUNDSVALL 1903.' The bottom left credits the publishers 'Flammén & Westerlund, Sundsvall,' and the bottom left of the card images the harbor ('Hamnen') of Sundsvall. The postcard is handwritten with a message and a signature, and it has a vintage look with a sepia tone.
